tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(daemon): omit shell-dependent result instruction when Bash is unavailable

beadle-vr0v: BuildSystemPrompt always told the worker to submit its
result via "ethos mission result ... --file <path>", a shell command.
A recipe declaring Tools: [] (no Bash) has no way to run it, deadlocking
multi-stage pipelines. BuildSystemPromptForTools now includes that line
only when Bash is in the declared tool set (or the set is nil, meaning
the default/full toolset). BuildSystemPrompt keeps its old signature and
behavior for existing callers, delegating to the new tools-aware variant
with tools=nil.
EOF
)"
